meta.description: Tests the meaning of recovery point objective.

question.text: A database has an RPO of 15 minutes. After a disaster, what does this requirement primarily limit?
options: The amount of data loss measured in time to approximately 15 minutes of transactions
The time allowed to restore all services to full operation
The maximum length of a copper Ethernet cable
The number of users who can authenticate
correctAnswers: The amount of data loss measured in time to approximately 15 minutes of transactions
